items.html: It is thus found that this phase is Tzadi, after the nine Sefirot of ZA himself, in which the aforementioned Mochin clothe, similar to phase two, called Lamed, after the third NHY of Tevuna, in which the Mochin clothe. And although here, too, it clothes within the NHY of Tevuna, still, since the NHY of Tevuna also clothe within the nine Sefirot of ZA, and they are revealed, it is therefore called Tzadi, after the nine Sefirot of ZA, which are the revealed ones.
